thread:
maya: Pushed a rebase for the kvcache-prefetch + batcher tweak in https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/5179 — small API change and a reorder that fixed a flake. Who can LGTM and run a quick perf sanity?
ravi: Happy to sanity-check. Running the smoke perf harness now (will use the nightly image).

ci-bot: CI started for PR #5179 — unit tests queued.

jen: quick glance: the change that moves prefetch initialization earlier looks fine. Can you paste the perf command you want us to run?

maya: Thanks. Use this locally or in the perf job:

```
./tools/perf/run.sh --model llama-13b --batch 8 --seq 1024 --prefetch true
```
Also try --seq 2048 if you have a GPU with enough memory. I'm mainly worried about a ~2-3% p50 increase on long sequences.

sam: I can run the 1024 and 2048 on a T4 in the perf pool in ~10m and post numbers. Will also check kv hit rate metrics.

ravi: Running now. Quick note: I saw one failing unit test locally (test_batcher_timing) but that might be unrelated — will re-run after CI finishes.

ci-bot: CI update: build passed, tests 411/413, flaky: test_batcher_timing (rerun queued).

jen: If the perf numbers look OK and CI flakes disappear, I'm fine to approve. Need one more approval after me for the merge guard (we require 2).

maya: Sounds good. Plan: hold merge until 3pm PT to give folks time to run perf. If no regressions, I'll merge in the 3-4pm window and kick a canary rollout to dedicated. If regressions, revert and open a follow-up.

sam: Results: p50 for seq1024 = 31.2ms (baseline 30.8ms), seq2048 = 68.1ms (baseline 66.9ms). KV hit rate unchanged. Looks within noise.

ravi: Re-ran unit tests after cleaning workspace — all green now. No flaky repro.

jen: LGTM from me.

maya: @ravi or @sam can you add the second LGTM so I can merge? Also tag the rollout ticket: https://redwood-internal/board/rollouts/629

ravi: LGTM.

maya: Thanks everyone — merging after CI completes. I'll monitor canary and post any anomalies. :rocket:
